name: Hearing loss
source_note: Sample: 'hard of hearing' is recorded in the medical history line.
desc: Sample condition entry describing how hearing loss affects daily care routines and communication.

evidence.summary: Sample evidence: 'hard of hearing' appears in the medical history line, and 12 of the last 60 visit notes mention the TV/radio being very loud or carers needing to speak face-to-face.

triggers: Carer notes about hearing aids not charged or TV volume very high.
staff: Face the person, speak clearly, check hearing aids are on charge at every call.
comfort: Regular retube and review appointments; note hearing-aid maintenance in the log.

name: Memory issues
source_note: Sample: recorded in the portal medical history line.
desc: Sample entry: memory issues mean routines, orientation cues and consistent carers matter.

evidence.summary: Sample evidence: memory & cognition flags across notes analytics — repeated questions, lost-words moments and two wandering-adjacent notes in the flagged period.

triggers: Notes describing confusion about time, place or recent events.
staff: Use orientation strategies, keep routines consistent, explain every step.
comfort: Dementia-friendly activities; involve the memory clinic/team as applicable.

name: Anxiety
source_note: Sample: recorded in the medical history line.
desc: Sample entry describing anxiety around care interactions and at night.

evidence.summary: Sample evidence: carer notes describing agitation in the late afternoon, settled by routine and the radio; one GP annotation about anxiety management.

triggers: Unfamiliar carers, rushed calls, night-time disorientation.
staff: Announce arrival, take time, keep the same visit order.
comfort: Calm evening routine; log what helps so the whole team can use it.

name: Osteoarthritis (knee)
source_note: Sample: recorded in the medical history line.
desc: Sample entry: knee osteoarthritis affects mobility and transfers; watch for pain signals.

evidence.summary: Sample evidence: knee pain noted on stairs and in wet weather; PRN analgesia recorded in the medication events; mobility notes reference the walking stick.

triggers: Notes mentioning knee pain or difficulty on stairs.
staff: Allow extra time for moves, use agreed transfer technique.
comfort: Prompt PRN analgesia as prescribed; report escalating pain.
